categories.name: Fiction & Novels
categories.description: Step beyond everyday experience into worlds shaped by imagination. From emotional journeys and mysteries to literary classics, fiction lets you live other lives and return with fresh perspective.
categories.audience: Readers who love character-driven stories, book clubs and anyone who wants to unwind with depth.

categories.name: Science & Technology
categories.description: Understand how the natural and engineered world works, from atoms and genes to satellites and clean energy, explained with clarity and real-world examples.
categories.audience: Science students, curious generalists and professionals who want to follow modern discoveries.

categories.name: History & Civilization
categories.description: Trace the empires, trade routes and ideas that built the modern world, and see how past choices still shape the present.
categories.audience: History students, travellers and readers who enjoy narrative non-fiction.

categories.name: Islamic Books
categories.description: Reliable, thoughtfully written titles on faith, practice, history and character, suitable for personal study and family reading.
categories.audience: Students of knowledge, parents, new learners and anyone seeking spiritual reflection.

categories.name: Self-Development
categories.description: Practical guides to habits, focus, confidence and well-being. Small, repeatable ideas that help you build the life you want.
categories.audience: Students, early-career professionals and anyone starting a fresh chapter.

categories.name: Business & Finance
categories.description: Clear introductions to entrepreneurship, accounting, markets and leadership, written for people who need to make decisions with money.
categories.audience: Founders, business students, managers and first-time investors.

categories.name: Computer Science & IT
categories.description: Core computing knowledge from programming and algorithms to networks, databases and security, with worked examples you can run.
categories.audience: CS and IT students, self-taught developers and engineers refreshing fundamentals.

categories.name: Psychology & Philosophy
categories.description: Explore how people think, feel and decide, and the big questions about knowledge, ethics and meaning that have occupied thinkers for centuries.
categories.audience: Psychology and philosophy students, counsellors and reflective readers.

categories.name: Education & Academics
categories.description: Tools for studying, researching, writing and teaching well, from exam strategy to thesis planning and classroom leadership.
categories.audience: School and university students, researchers and teachers.

categories.name: Biography & Memoirs
categories.description: Real lives told with honesty: scientists, teachers, travellers and builders whose journeys offer lessons in resilience and purpose.
categories.audience: Readers who learn best from personal stories and mentors in print.
